title: Buchstaber, Ochanine, Krichever, and Witten Genera
summary: We introduce a new class of one-dimensional commutative formal group laws with formal inverse $\bar u=-u$ whose modulus square construction yields Buchstaber's family of polynomials, and prove that the formal group law $F_{\mathrm{Bc}}(u,v)$ is universal for this class over commutative $\mathbb{Z}[1/2]$-algebras. This class is related to, but does not coincide with, the family of formal group laws associated with the Krichever genus.
